_note: 寫作（writing）島 sidecar：一頁多單元。strand=writing。本批 3 個單元覆蓋 5 個知識點：W1 照著抄寫與仿寫（copy-imitate，t_base）；W2 造完整句＋大小寫與標點（sentence-making／punctuation-caps，t_mid）；W3 看圖寫句＋寫簡單信/email（picture-basic／letter-email，t_mid）。英語島治理：語感＞文法、英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文零 CJK，中文對照放 zh_hint、預設收合），國小高年級／TOEIC 600-750 可讀的簡單英文，不教台式對比。寫作無法自動批改，故每單元用兩種 practice 混合：(1) 客觀子技能 MCQ（type:mcq、validation_method:expert）測寫作的可客觀判定子技能（句子抄得對不對、是不是完整句、大小寫標點對不對、email 署名放哪裡、哪一句正確描述了圖），有唯一正解、綁 answer_evidence 指向本單元 claims、每個錯項附 distractor_rationales，這類題承載 rubric⑦ 真教真考；(2) 自評產出題（type:writing、validation_method:self）要學生自己寫（抄寫／仿寫／造句／看圖寫一句／寫問候），題目在 answer 欄給明確 model answer／範例，絕不假裝自動批改手寫作文，selfeval_note 要學生對照範例自己判斷（寫對意思即可、用字不必一字不差）→SRS。看圖題的圖內容一律用英文文字描述放在 stem。每個宣告的知識點都在某 teach 段與某 MCQ 的 kp_ids 出現（rubric⑦ 綁定成立，不依賴自評題）。英文示範句／標點／格式／model answer 皆以 Cambridge English 等權威查證、status:provisional、risk_class:normal、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。

units.title_zh: 照著抄寫與仿寫句子（copy & imitate）
units.can_do: 我能把一個英文句子一字不差地照抄下來（連大小寫和標點都對），也能照著一個範例句的句型，只換掉一個字，寫出我自己的新句子。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When you copy a sentence, you write it exactly as it is: every letter, every space, the capital letter at the start and in names, and the punctuation mark at the end. You do not add or drop anything.
claims.verification_ref: 抄寫一個句子＝一模一樣寫下來：每個字母、每個空格、句首與名字的大寫、句尾的標點都照抄，不增不減；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To imitate a sentence, you keep the same pattern (the same frame of words) and change only one part, such as the noun. The new sentence has the same shape as the model sentence.
claims.verification_ref: 仿寫一個句子＝保留相同句型（相同的字框架），只換掉其中一個部分（例如名詞）；新句子和範例句結構相同；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you copy a sentence, write it exactly the same. Copy every letter and every space. Keep the capital letter at the start, and keep capital letters in names like 'Tom'. Keep the end mark, such as a period (.). Do not add or drop anything.
teach.zh_hint: 抄寫一個句子時，要一模一樣地寫下來。每個字母、每個空格都照抄。句首的大寫、像 Tom 這種名字的大寫都要保留，句尾的標點（例如句點 .）也要保留。不要多加或漏掉任何東西。

teach.body: To imitate a sentence, keep the same pattern and change only one word. If the model is 'I like apples.', you can change the last word and write 'I like bananas.' The shape of the sentence stays the same.
teach.zh_hint: 仿寫一個句子時，保留相同的句型，只換掉一個字。如果範例是 'I like apples.'，你可以換掉最後一個字，寫成 'I like bananas.'，句子的結構維持不變。

teach.body: Model: 'The cat is black.' Copy it: 'The cat is black.' (exactly the same). Imitate it: 'The cat is white.' (same pattern, only one word changed).
teach.zh_hint: 範例：'The cat is black.'。照抄：'The cat is black.'（一模一樣）。仿寫：'The cat is white.'（句型相同，只換了一個字）。

teach.body: Your turn to copy: write this sentence exactly, keeping the capital letter and the period — 'My brother has a new bike.' A correct copy looks exactly the same: My brother has a new bike.
teach.zh_hint: 換你照抄：把這句一字不差寫下來（句首大寫、句尾句點都要）——'My brother has a new bike.'。對照範例自己檢查（不自動批改）：句首 My 大寫、每個字拼對、句尾有句點，就算對。寫完用下面的三級自評。

teach.body: Your turn to imitate: keep the pattern 'I like ___.' and change only the last word to a food you like. Example answers: I like bananas. / I like rice.
teach.zh_hint: 換你仿寫：保留句型 'I like ___.'，只換最後一個字，寫出你喜歡的一種食物。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：句型是 'I like ___.'、換的是一種食物、拼寫正確即可（用字不必和範例一樣）。範例：I like bananas.／I like rice.。

practice.stem: 範例句是 'I have a red ball.'。下面哪一句是把它『完全正確地照抄』下來？
practice.answer: I have a red ball.
options: I have a red ball.
i have a red ball.
I have a red ball
I have a red boll.

句首的 I 沒有大寫；照抄時句首大寫要保留。
distractor_rationales.I have a red ball: 句尾漏了句點（.）；照抄時句尾標點要保留。
把 ball 抄錯成 boll，改動了字；照抄不能改動任何字。

practice.feedback: 照抄＝一字不差：句首 I 大寫、每個字拼對、句尾句點都保留，所以 'I have a red ball.' 才完全正確。

practice.stem: 範例句是 'She likes dogs.'。哪一句是正確的『仿寫』——句型一樣，只換掉其中的名詞？
practice.answer: She likes cats.
options: She likes cats.
She likes dogs very much.
She like cats.
Dogs likes she.

多加了 very much，句型變長了；仿寫只換一個字，不加字。
動詞漏了 -s（主詞 She 要用 likes）；仿寫要保留原句型，包括 likes。
把字的順序打亂了，句型完全不同，不是仿寫。

practice.feedback: 仿寫＝保留 'She likes ___.' 的句型，只把名詞 dogs 換成 cats，寫成 'She likes cats.'。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你抄好／仿寫好的句子出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊檢查有沒有漏字、句首大小寫和句尾標點對不對。

lines.text: My brother has a new bike.

units.title_zh: 造出完整句＋大小寫與標點（complete sentences & punctuation）
units.can_do: 我能寫出有主詞和動詞、意思完整的句子，也能正確地用大小寫（句首、人名地名）、句尾標點（. ? !）和條列用的逗號。
units.situation_group: 寫作：完整句與標點大小寫
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A complete sentence has a subject (who or what the sentence is about) and a verb (what the subject does or is), and it makes complete sense on its own. For example, 'Birds fly.' has a subject (Birds) and a verb (fly), so it is a complete sentence.
claims.verification_ref: 完整句＝有主詞（這句在講的人或東西）和動詞（主詞做什麼或是什麼），而且本身意思完整；例 'Birds fly.' 有主詞 Birds、動詞 fly，是完整句；屬英語基礎語法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In English you begin every sentence with a capital letter, and you also capitalize proper nouns — the names of people, days, months, and places, such as 'Anna', 'Monday', and 'Taipei'.
claims.verification_ref: 英文每句句首要大寫，專有名詞（人名、星期、月份、地名，如 Anna／Monday／Taipei）也要大寫；屬英語標準大小寫規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Every sentence ends with a punctuation mark: a period (.) for a statement, a question mark (?) for a question, and an exclamation mark (!) for a strong feeling.
claims.verification_ref: 每句句尾要有標點：直述句用句點（.）、問句用問號（?）、強烈情緒用驚嘆號（!）；屬英語標準標點規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: You use a comma (,) to separate three or more items in a list, for example: 'I like milk, juice, and water.'
claims.verification_ref: 條列三樣或以上的東西時，各項之間用逗號（,）隔開，例 'I like milk, juice, and water.'；屬英語標準標點規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A complete sentence needs two things: a subject and a verb. The subject is who or what the sentence is about. The verb tells what the subject does or is. The sentence must also make complete sense on its own. For example, 'Birds fly.' has a subject (Birds) and a verb (fly), so it is complete. A group of words like 'the happy dog' has no verb, so it is not a sentence yet.
teach.zh_hint: 一個完整的句子需要兩樣東西：主詞和動詞。主詞是這句話在講的人或東西，動詞說明主詞做什麼或是什麼。句子本身還要意思完整。例如 'Birds fly.' 有主詞（Birds）和動詞（fly），所以是完整句；像 'the happy dog' 這樣只有一串字、沒有動詞，還不算句子。

teach.body: Begin every sentence with a capital letter. Also use a capital letter for proper nouns: names of people, days, months, and places, like 'Anna', 'Monday', and 'Taipei'. End a statement with a period (.), a question with a question mark (?), and a strong feeling with an exclamation mark (!). When you list three or more things, put a comma between them: 'I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.'
teach.zh_hint: 每句句首要用大寫。專有名詞也要大寫：人名、星期、月份、地名，例如 Anna、Monday、Taipei。直述句句尾用句點（.），問句用問號（?），強烈情緒用驚嘆號（!）。條列三樣或以上的東西時，各項之間要加逗號：'I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.'

teach.body: Not a sentence: 'the happy dog' — it has no verb and no capital or end mark. Complete and correct: 'The happy dog runs.' — it starts with a capital 'The', has a subject (The happy dog) and a verb (runs), and ends with a period.
teach.zh_hint: 不是句子：'the happy dog'——沒有動詞，也沒有大寫和句尾標點。完整又正確：'The happy dog runs.'——句首 The 大寫、有主詞（The happy dog）和動詞（runs）、句尾有句點。

teach.body: Your turn: write one complete sentence about a family member. It must have a subject and a verb, start with a capital letter, and end with a period. Example answers: My mother cooks dinner. / My father reads books.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一個關於家人的完整句子。要有主詞、有動詞，句首大寫、句尾加句點。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有主詞有動詞、意思完整、大寫與句點都對即可（用字可不同）。範例：My mother cooks dinner.／My father reads books.。

teach.body: Your turn: rewrite this line with correct capital letters and punctuation — 'my friend tom lives in taipei'. Correct version: My friend Tom lives in Taipei.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這一行改成大小寫和標點都正確的句子——'my friend tom lives in taipei'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：句首 My 大寫、人名 Tom 與地名 Taipei 大寫、句尾加句點。正解：My friend Tom lives in Taipei.。

practice.stem: 下面哪一個是『完整的句子』（有主詞也有動詞，意思完整）？
practice.answer: The children play in the park.
options: The children play in the park.
A big yellow school bus.
Running very fast.
In the morning.

這只有一個名詞詞組，沒有動詞，所以不是完整句。
沒有主詞（是誰在跑？），所以不是完整句。
這是一個片語，沒有主詞也沒有動詞，不是完整句。

practice.feedback: 'The children play in the park.' 有主詞（The children）和動詞（play），意思完整，所以是完整句。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句的大小寫和句尾標點『全部正確』？
practice.answer: My friend Anna lives in Taipei.
options: My friend Anna lives in Taipei.
my friend anna lives in taipei.
My friend Anna lives in Taipei
my Friend Anna lives in Taipei.

句首 my 沒大寫，人名 anna 和地名 taipei 也沒大寫。
句首 my 沒大寫，卻把普通字 Friend 大寫了，大小寫用錯地方。

practice.feedback: 'My friend Anna lives in Taipei.'：句首 My 大寫、人名 Anna 與地名 Taipei 大寫、句尾有句點，全部正確。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句在條列三樣東西時，逗號用得正確？
practice.answer: I like milk, juice, and water.
options: I like milk, juice, and water.
I like milk juice and water.
I like, milk, juice and water.
I, like milk, juice and water.

三樣東西之間完全沒有逗號隔開。
逗號放錯位置（like 後面不該放逗號），而且 juice 和 water 之間也漏了逗號。
在主詞 I 後面放了不該有的逗號，條列的逗號也不齊。

practice.feedback: 條列三樣東西時，各項之間用逗號隔開：'I like milk, juice, and water.' 的逗號位置正確。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的句子出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊確認『有沒有主詞和動詞』『句首大寫、句尾標點對不對』。

lines.text: My friend Tom lives in Taipei.

units.title_zh: 看圖寫句＋寫簡單的信/email（picture & email）
units.can_do: 我能看一張圖，用簡單的句子寫出圖裡有誰、在做什麼、在哪裡；也能寫一封給朋友的短 email，包含問候語、本文、以及結尾署名加自己的名字。
units.situation_group: 寫作：看圖寫句與書信格式
units.subject: eng

claims.text: To describe a picture, write simple sentences about what you see: who is in the picture, what they are doing, and where they are. You can begin with 'There is' or 'There are' to say what the picture shows.
claims.verification_ref: 看圖寫句＝用簡單句子寫出看到的內容：圖裡有誰、在做什麼、在哪裡；可用 'There is／There are' 開頭說明圖中有什麼；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A short email to a friend has three basic parts: a greeting at the top (for a friend, 'Hi Anna,' or 'Dear Anna,'), the body in the middle where you write your message, and a closing at the end with a sign-off and your name (for example, 'Your friend, Ben').
claims.verification_ref: 一封給朋友的短 email 有三個基本部分：最上面的問候語（朋友間用 'Hi Anna,' 或 'Dear Anna,'）、中間寫訊息的本文、最後的結尾（署名語＋自己的名字，例 'Your friend, Ben'）；屬英語基礎書信格式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The closing comes last, after the body. A friendly sign-off such as 'Your friend,' or 'Best wishes,' is written on its own line, and your own name goes on the line below it.
claims.verification_ref: 結尾放在最後、本文之後；友善的署名語（如 'Your friend,' 或 'Best wishes,'）單獨寫一行，自己的名字寫在它的下一行；屬英語基礎書信格式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you describe a picture, look carefully and write simple sentences about what you see. Say who is in the picture, what they are doing, and where they are. You can start with 'There is a ...' or 'There are ...'. For example: 'There is a boy. He is riding a bike in the park.'
teach.zh_hint: 看圖寫作時，仔細看圖，用簡單的句子寫出你看到的東西。說出圖裡有誰、他們在做什麼、在哪裡。可以用 'There is a ...' 或 'There are ...' 開頭。例如：'There is a boy. He is riding a bike in the park.'

teach.body: A short email to a friend has three parts. First comes the greeting, such as 'Hi Anna,'. Next comes the body, where you write your message. Last comes the closing: a friendly sign-off like 'Your friend,' on one line, and your own name on the next line.
teach.zh_hint: 一封給朋友的短 email 有三個部分。最先是問候語，例如 'Hi Anna,'。接著是本文，寫你要說的訊息。最後是結尾：友善的署名語（例如 'Your friend,'）寫一行，自己的名字寫在下一行。

teach.body: Picture (in words): a girl is sitting at a table and eating an apple. You can write: 'A girl is sitting at a table. She is eating an apple.' Short email: 'Hi Anna,' / 'I am having fun at camp. See you soon!' / 'Your friend,' / 'Ben'.
teach.zh_hint: 圖（用文字描述）：一個女孩坐在桌子旁吃蘋果。你可以寫：'A girl is sitting at a table. She is eating an apple.'。短 email：'Hi Anna,'／'I am having fun at camp. See you soon!'／'Your friend,'／'Ben'。

teach.body: Your turn: look at this picture (in words) — 'A girl is reading a book under a tree.' Write one sentence to describe it. Example answers: A girl is reading a book under a tree. / There is a girl. She is reading under a tree.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：看這張圖（文字描述）——'A girl is reading a book under a tree.'，寫一句英文描述它。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：寫出『誰、在做什麼、在哪裡』、是完整句、拼寫大致正確即可（用字可不同）。範例：A girl is reading a book under a tree.／There is a girl. She is reading under a tree.。

teach.body: Your turn: write a short email to a friend with three parts — a greeting, one line of body, and a closing with your name (four lines). Example: Hi Anna, / I am having fun at camp. See you soon! / Your friend, / Ben.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一封給朋友的短 email，含三部分——問候語、一句本文、結尾署名＋自己的名字（可分四行）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：朋友名字和內容可不同，只要三部分齊全、格式正確即可。範例：Hi Anna,／I am having fun at camp. See you soon!／Your friend,／Ben。

practice.stem: 看這張圖（圖的內容以英文描述）：'A boy is riding a bicycle in the park. The sun is shining.' 下面哪一句正確地描述了這張圖？
practice.answer: A boy is riding his bike in the park.
options: A boy is riding his bike in the park.
A girl is riding a bike in the park.
A boy is walking in the park.
A boy is riding a bike at school.

圖裡是一個男孩（a boy），不是女孩。
圖裡的男孩在『騎腳踏車』，不是走路。
圖裡的地點是公園（in the park），不是學校。

practice.feedback: 圖的描述說 a boy is riding a bicycle in the park，所以正確描述是 'A boy is riding his bike in the park.'——人物、動作、地點都相符。

practice.stem: 一封寫給朋友 Anna 的 email，下面哪一句最適合當『開頭的問候語』？
practice.answer: Hi Anna,
options: Hi Anna,
Your friend, Ben
I am fine, thank you.
The end.

distractor_rationales.Your friend, Ben: 這是放在最後的結尾署名，不是開頭的問候語。
這是本文裡的一句話，不是問候語。
這不是 email 會用的句子，也不是問候語。

practice.feedback: 寫給朋友的 email，開頭的問候語用 'Hi Anna,'（或 'Dear Anna,'）放在最上面。

practice.stem: 一封 email 的『結尾署名』應該放在哪裡、怎麼寫？
practice.answer: 放在本文之後的最後面：先寫 'Your friend,'，下一行再寫自己的名字。
options: 放在本文之後的最後面：先寫 'Your friend,'，下一行再寫自己的名字。
放在最前面，問候語的前面。
放在本文的中間。
署名要寫收件人的名字，不是自己的名字。

distractor_rationales.放在最前面，問候語的前面。: 結尾署名是放在最後、本文之後，不是放在最前面。
distractor_rationales.放在本文的中間。: 結尾署名要放在整封信的最後，不是夾在本文中間。
distractor_rationales.署名要寫收件人的名字，不是自己的名字。: 署名寫的是『寄信人自己』的名字，不是收件人的名字。

practice.feedback: 結尾放最後、本文之後：署名語 'Your friend,' 寫一行，自己的名字寫在下一行。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

units.title_zh: 段落結構＋連貫詞（paragraph structure & cohesive devices）
units.can_do: 我能寫出有主題句、支持句和結尾句的段落，也能用 first／also／however／for example／therefore 等連貫詞，把句子順暢地串連起來。
units.situation_group: 寫作：段落組織與篇章連貫
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A good paragraph has three parts: a topic sentence that gives the main idea, supporting sentences that add details, reasons, or examples, and a closing sentence that finishes the idea. All the sentences are about the same one main idea.
claims.verification_ref: 好的段落有三個部分：點出主旨的主題句、補充細節／理由／例子的支持句、把想法收尾的結尾句；整段所有句子都圍繞同一個主旨；屬英語段落寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A topic sentence states the main idea of the whole paragraph. It is usually the first sentence, and it is more general than the supporting sentences, which give the specific details.
claims.verification_ref: 主題句點出整段的主旨，通常是第一句，而且比提供具體細節的支持句更概括（更一般）；屬英語段落寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Cohesive devices are linking words that connect ideas so a paragraph flows. Use 'first' to begin a point, 'also' to add another idea in the same direction, 'however' to show a contrast, 'for example' to give an example, and 'therefore' to show a result.
claims.verification_ref: 連貫詞是串連想法、讓段落通順的連接語：first 起頭、also 補充同方向的想法、however 表轉折、for example 舉例、therefore 表結果；屬英語篇章連貫通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A good paragraph has three parts. First is the topic sentence, which tells the main idea of the whole paragraph. Next come the supporting sentences, which add details, reasons, or examples about that idea. Last is the closing sentence, which finishes the idea. Keep every sentence about the same main idea. The topic sentence is more general; the supporting sentences are more specific.
teach.zh_hint: 好的段落有三個部分。第一是主題句，點出整段的主旨。接著是支持句，針對這個主旨補充細節、理由或例子。最後是結尾句，把想法收起來。整段每一句都圍繞同一個主旨。主題句比較概括，支持句比較具體。

teach.body: Cohesive devices are linking words that join your ideas so the paragraph flows. Use 'First,' to begin a point, 'Also,' to add another idea in the same direction, and 'However,' to show a contrast. Use 'For example,' to give an example, and 'Therefore,' to show a result. Choose the linking word that matches the meaning you want.
teach.zh_hint: 連貫詞是把想法連起來、讓段落通順的連接語。用 'First,' 起頭、用 'Also,' 補充同方向的另一個想法、用 'However,' 表示轉折。用 'For example,' 舉例、用 'Therefore,' 表示結果。依你要表達的意思挑對連貫詞。

teach.body: Model paragraph: 'Reading is a great hobby. First, it helps you learn new words. Also, it takes you to exciting places in your mind. However, some books can be hard, so you should start with easy ones. Therefore, reading is a fun way to learn.' The first sentence is the topic sentence, the middle sentences give details with linking words, and the last sentence closes the idea.
teach.zh_hint: 範例段落：'Reading is a great hobby. First, it helps you learn new words. Also, it takes you to exciting places in your mind. However, some books can be hard, so you should start with easy ones. Therefore, reading is a fun way to learn.'。第一句是主題句，中間幾句用連貫詞補充細節，最後一句把想法收尾。

teach.body: Your turn: write one topic sentence for a paragraph about why dogs make good pets. It should give the main idea and be general (not a small detail). Example answers: Dogs make wonderful pets for many reasons. / A dog can be a great friend to a family.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：為一段「為什麼狗是好寵物」寫一個主題句。要點出主旨、而且要概括（不是某個小細節）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有點出整段主旨、比細節更概括即可（用字可不同）。範例：Dogs make wonderful pets for many reasons.／A dog can be a great friend to a family.。

teach.body: Your turn: write two sentences about your weekend, and join them with a linking word that fits the meaning (such as 'Also,' to add, or 'However,' to contrast). Example answers: I played soccer on Saturday. Also, I read a good book. / I wanted to go out. However, it rained all day.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫兩句關於你週末的句子，用一個意思合適的連貫詞把它們連起來（例如補充用 'Also,'、轉折用 'However,'）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：兩句通順、連貫詞的意思用對即可（用字可不同）。範例：I played soccer on Saturday. Also, I read a good book.／I wanted to go out. However, it rained all day.。

practice.stem: 一個段落要講「為什麼狗是很好的寵物」。下面哪一句最適合當這個段落的『主題句』（點出整段主旨、比細節概括）？
practice.answer: Dogs make wonderful pets for many reasons.
options: Dogs make wonderful pets for many reasons.
My dog's name is Max.
Also, dogs can learn many tricks.
So, dogs are the best pets of all.

這是一個很小的細節（支持句都還不如），不能概括整段主旨。
這是用 'Also,' 補充的支持句，放在段落中間，不是主題句。
這是用 'So,' 收尾的結尾句，放在段落最後，不是開頭的主題句。

practice.feedback: 主題句要點出整段主旨、而且比細節概括：'Dogs make wonderful pets for many reasons.' 正好點出主旨、引出後面的理由。

practice.stem: 一段在講「為什麼運動對身體好」。下面哪一句最適合當這段的『結尾句』（把重點收起來）？
practice.answer: Therefore, exercise is a great way to stay healthy.
options: Therefore, exercise is a great way to stay healthy.
Exercise helps your heart stay strong.
There are many good reasons to exercise.
My favorite sport is swimming.

這是一個具體理由（支持句），放在段落中間，不是把重點收起來的結尾句。
這比較像開頭的主題句（引出後面的理由），不是結尾句。
這是一個離題的小細節，既不是主旨，也沒把段落收尾。

practice.feedback: 結尾句放在最後、把整段重點收起來：'Therefore, exercise is a great way to stay healthy.' 用 Therefore 帶出結論，收束前面講的理由。

practice.stem: 填入最合適的連貫詞：'I wanted to play outside. ___, it was raining, so I stayed inside.'
practice.answer: However
options: However
For example
Therefore
First

distractor_rationales.For example: For example 是用來『舉例』的，但這裡不是舉例，而是『想出去卻下雨』的轉折。
distractor_rationales.Therefore: Therefore 表示『結果』，但下雨不是『想出去』造成的結果，這裡是轉折。
distractor_rationales.First: First 用來點出『第一步／第一點』的順序，放在這裡意思不通。

practice.feedback: 想出去玩、卻下雨不能出去——前後是『相反』的轉折，所以用 However：'I wanted to play outside. However, it was raining, so I stayed inside.'。

practice.stem: 你已經寫了一個理由，想『再補充一個同方向的理由』，句子開頭用哪個連貫詞最合適？
practice.answer: Also,
options: Also,
However,
In contrast,
On the other hand,

distractor_rationales.However,: However 表示『轉折、相反』，不是補充同方向的理由。
distractor_rationales.In contrast,: In contrast 用來帶出『相反、對比』的內容，不是補充同方向的理由。
distractor_rationales.On the other hand,: On the other hand 用來講『另一面、相反的看法』，不是補充同方向的理由。

practice.feedback: 要『再補充一個同方向的理由』用 Also,（例如 'Dogs are friendly. Also, they are easy to train.'）；However／In contrast／On the other hand 都是表轉折或對比。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的段落出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊檢查『有沒有主題句、支持句、結尾句』『連貫詞的意思用對了嗎』。

units.title_zh: 命題作文結構＋一致性（essay structure & consistency）
units.can_do: 我能用開頭—主體—結尾的結構寫一篇短的命題作文，也能讓整篇的時態一致、人稱一致、主詞和動詞一致。
units.situation_group: 寫作：命題作文與一致性
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A short topic essay has three main parts: an introduction that tells the topic and your main point, a body that gives reasons and examples, and a conclusion that restates your main point. This is the basic beginning-middle-end shape of an essay.
claims.verification_ref: 短的命題作文有三個主要部分：點出題目與主要觀點的開頭、提供理由與例子的主體、重申主要觀點的結尾；這就是作文「開頭—主體—結尾」的基本結構；屬英語作文通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Keep the same tense through your writing unless the time really changes. If you are writing about something that happened in the past, keep all the verbs for that event in the past tense, such as 'went' and 'saw', not 'went' and 'see'.
claims.verification_ref: 除非時間真的改變，整篇要保持相同時態；寫過去發生的事，同一件事的動詞都要用過去式，例如 went 和 saw，而不是 went 配 see；屬英語語法一致性通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Keep the same person (point of view) for the same idea. If you begin writing about 'I', do not suddenly switch to 'you' or 'we' for the same idea.
claims.verification_ref: 同一個想法要保持相同人稱（視角）；開頭用「I」寫，就不要在同一個想法裡突然換成「you」或「we」；屬英語寫作一致性通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Make the verb agree with the subject. A singular subject takes a singular verb ('She walks.'), and a plural subject takes a plural verb ('They walk.'). In the present simple, a singular third-person subject usually takes a verb ending in -s.
claims.verification_ref: 動詞要和主詞一致：單數主詞配單數動詞（She walks.），複數主詞配複數動詞（They walk.）；一般現在式中，第三人稱單數主詞的動詞通常加 -s；屬英語主謂一致標準規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A short topic essay has three parts, like a beginning, a middle, and an end. The introduction comes first: it tells the topic and your main point. The body comes in the middle: it gives your reasons and examples, often one reason in each sentence or group of sentences. The conclusion comes last: it restates your main point in a new way. This clear shape helps the reader follow your writing.
teach.zh_hint: 短的命題作文有三個部分，就像開頭、中間、結尾。開頭在最前面：點出題目和你的主要觀點。主體在中間：提供你的理由和例子，常常一個理由寫一句或一小段。結尾在最後：用不同的說法重申你的主要觀點。這個清楚的結構能幫讀者跟上你的文章。

teach.body: Good writing is consistent in three ways. Tense: keep the same tense unless the time really changes; for a past event, use 'went' and 'saw', not 'went' and 'see'. Person: keep the same point of view for the same idea; if you start with 'I', do not switch to 'you' in the same idea. Subject and verb: make them agree, such as 'She walks' (singular) and 'They walk' (plural).
teach.zh_hint: 好的文章在三方面要一致。時態：除非時間真的改變，否則保持相同時態；寫過去的事用 went 和 saw，不要 went 配 see。人稱：同一個想法保持相同視角；開頭用 I，就不要在同一想法裡換成 you。主謂：主詞和動詞要一致，例如 She walks（單數）、They walk（複數）。

teach.body: Model outline for the topic 'My favorite season': Introduction — 'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.' Body — 'First, I can swim at the beach. Also, the days are long, so I have more time to play.' Conclusion — 'For these reasons, summer is the best season for me.' Notice every verb stays in the present tense, and the writer stays with 'I' all the way through.
teach.zh_hint: 以「My favorite season」為題的範例大綱：開頭——'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.'；主體——'First, I can swim at the beach. Also, the days are long, so I have more time to play.'；結尾——'For these reasons, summer is the best season for me.'。注意每個動詞都保持現在式，而且整篇都用「I」。

teach.body: Your turn: write one introduction sentence for the topic 'My favorite food'. It should name the topic and give your main point (your opinion). Example answers: My favorite food is noodles because they are warm and tasty. / I think pizza is the best food of all.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：為題目「My favorite food」寫一句開頭句。要點出題目、並給出你的主要觀點（你的看法）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有點出題目＋表達你的看法即可（用字可不同）。範例：My favorite food is noodles because they are warm and tasty.／I think pizza is the best food of all.。

teach.body: Your turn: rewrite this line so the tense is consistent (make it all past tense) — 'Last weekend I visit my grandma and eat lunch with her.' Example answer: Last weekend I visited my grandma and ate lunch with her.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這一行改成時態一致（整句都用過去式）——'Last weekend I visit my grandma and eat lunch with her.'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：visit→visited、eat→ate，兩個動詞都變過去式才一致。正解：Last weekend I visited my grandma and ate lunch with her.。

practice.stem: 寫一篇題目是「My favorite season」的短作文，下面哪一句最適合放在『開頭』（點出題目＋你的主要觀點）？
practice.answer: My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.
options: My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.
First, I can swim at the beach.
For these reasons, summer is the best season for me.
The water was cold that day.

這是主體裡用 'First,' 帶出的一個理由，放在中間，不是開頭。
distractor_rationales.For these reasons, summer is the best se: 這是結尾句（重申主要觀點），放在最後，不是開頭。
這是一個離題又跳到過去式的小細節，不適合當點出主要觀點的開頭。

practice.feedback: 開頭要點出題目＋你的主要觀點：'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.' 正好說出題目（season）和你的看法（summer＋理由）。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句『時態前後一致』（整句都在講過去發生的事）？
practice.answer: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.
options: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.
Yesterday I go to the zoo and saw a tiger.
Yesterday I went to the zoo and see a tiger.
Yesterday I go to the zoo and see a tiger.

distractor_rationales.Yesterday I go to the zoo and saw a tige: go 是現在式、saw 是過去式，同一件過去的事時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.Yesterday I went to the zoo and see a ti: went 是過去式、see 是現在式，同一件過去的事時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.Yesterday I go to the zoo and see a tige: 兩個動詞都是現在式，但 'Yesterday'（昨天）是過去，應該用過去式。

practice.feedback: 'Yesterday' 是過去，兩個動詞都要用過去式才一致：went 和 saw——'Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.'。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句的『主詞和動詞一致』（agree）？
practice.answer: The two boys play soccer every day.
options: The two boys play soccer every day.
The two boys plays soccer every day.
My brother play soccer every day.
She play soccer every day.

主詞 'The two boys' 是複數，動詞不該加 -s，應該用 play。
主詞 'My brother' 是第三人稱單數，動詞應該用 plays。
主詞 'She' 是第三人稱單數，動詞應該用 plays。

practice.feedback: 複數主詞 'The two boys' 配複數動詞 play：'The two boys play soccer every day.' 主謂一致。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句『人稱前後一致』（同一個想法從頭到尾用同一個人稱）？
practice.answer: When I feel tired, I take a short rest.
options: When I feel tired, I take a short rest.
When I feel tired, you take a short rest.
When you feel tired, I take a short rest.
When I feel tired, we take a short rest.

distractor_rationales.When I feel tired, you take a short rest: 前半用 'I'、後半突然換成 'you'，同一個想法裡人稱跳掉了。
distractor_rationales.When you feel tired, I take a short rest: 前半用 'you'、後半換成 'I'，同一個想法裡人稱不一致。
前半用 'I'、後半換成 'we'，同一個想法裡人稱不一致。

practice.feedback: 同一個想法從頭到尾都用 'I' 才一致：'When I feel tired, I take a short rest.'。

units.title_zh: 記敘文＋看圖說故事（narrative & picture story）
units.can_do: 我能依時間順序寫一件事，有開始、經過和結果；也能看一組圖，把每張圖的內容寫成一個連貫的短故事。
units.situation_group: 寫作：記敘文與看圖說故事
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A narrative tells about one event in time order. It has a beginning that sets the scene (who, where, and when), a middle that tells what happened, and an end that tells how it finished.
claims.verification_ref: 記敘文依時間順序說一件事：有交代場景（誰、在哪裡、什麼時候）的開始、說明發生什麼的經過、以及說明如何結束的結果；屬英語記敘文通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Time words help readers follow the order of events in a story. Use 'first' for what happens at the start, 'then' or 'after that' for what happens next, and 'finally' for what happens last.
claims.verification_ref: 時間順序詞幫讀者跟上故事的事件順序：first 用於最先發生的事、then 或 after that 用於接下來、finally 用於最後發生的事；屬英語記敘文通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When you write a story from a set of pictures, look at the pictures in order and write one or two sentences for each one. Use time words to connect them, so the sentences join into one short story that makes sense from start to end.
claims.verification_ref: 看一組圖寫故事時，依順序看圖，每張圖寫一到兩句，並用時間順序詞連接，讓句子串成一個從頭到尾合理的短故事；屬英語看圖寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A narrative tells about one event in time order. It has three stages. The beginning sets the scene: who is in the story, where they are, and when it happens. The middle tells what happened, step by step in the order it happened. The end tells how it finished. Keep the events in the order they really happened, so the reader can follow your story.
teach.zh_hint: 記敘文依時間順序說一件事，有三個階段。開始交代場景：故事裡有誰、在哪裡、什麼時候發生。經過說明發生了什麼，依發生的順序一步一步說。結果說明事情如何結束。把事件照真正發生的順序排好，讀者才跟得上你的故事。

teach.body: To write a story from a set of pictures, look at the pictures in order, one by one. Write one or two sentences for each picture about what you see. Then join the sentences with time words like 'First,', 'Then,', 'After that,', and 'Finally,'. This turns the separate pictures into one short story that makes sense from start to end.
teach.zh_hint: 看一組圖寫故事時，依順序一張一張看圖。每張圖就你看到的內容寫一到兩句。接著用時間順序詞把句子連起來，例如 'First,'、'Then,'、'After that,'、'Finally,'。這樣就能把分開的圖變成一個從頭到尾合理的短故事。

teach.body: Model story from four pictures (in words): (1) a boy plants a seed, (2) he waters it, (3) a small plant grows, (4) the plant has a flower. You can write: 'First, a boy planted a seed in a pot. Then he watered it every day. After that, a small plant grew. Finally, it had a beautiful flower.' The beginning sets the scene, the middle tells what happened in order, and the end tells how it finished.
teach.zh_hint: 用四張圖（文字描述）寫的範例故事：(1) 一個男孩種下種子、(2) 他澆水、(3) 一株小植物長出來、(4) 植物開了花。你可以寫：'First, a boy planted a seed in a pot. Then he watered it every day. After that, a small plant grew. Finally, it had a beautiful flower.'。開始交代場景，經過照順序說發生了什麼，結果說明如何結束。

teach.body: Your turn: write the beginning sentence of a story about a trip. It should set the scene — say who, and when or where. Example answers: One sunny morning, my family drove to the beach. / Last summer, Ben and his sister visited their grandparents.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一個關於出遊的故事的開頭句。要交代場景——說出是誰，以及什麼時候或在哪裡。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有交代人物＋時間或地點即可（用字可不同）。範例：One sunny morning, my family drove to the beach.／Last summer, Ben and his sister visited their grandparents.。

teach.body: Your turn: look at these three pictures (in words) — (1) a girl finds a lost cat, (2) she gives it some milk, (3) the cat's owner thanks her. Write one sentence for each, joined with time words. Example answer: First, a girl found a lost cat near her house. Then she gave it some milk. Finally, the cat's owner thanked her.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：看這三張圖（文字描述）——(1) 一個女孩發現一隻走失的貓、(2) 她給牠一些牛奶、(3) 貓的主人向她道謝。每張圖寫一句、用時間順序詞連起來。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：三句照圖的順序、用上時間順序詞、串成連貫故事即可（用字可不同）。範例：First, a girl found a lost cat near her house. Then she gave it some milk. Finally, the cat's owner thanked her.。

practice.stem: 一個故事要開始，下面哪一句最適合當『開頭』（交代場景：誰、什麼時候或在哪裡）？
practice.answer: One Saturday morning, Ben and his sister went to the beach.
options: One Saturday morning, Ben and his sister went to the beach.
Finally, they went home feeling happy.
They built a big sandcastle together.
It was a lot of fun.

這用 'Finally,' 說最後的事，是故事的結果，不是開頭。
這是故事中間發生的一件事（經過），不是交代場景的開頭。
這只是籠統的感想，沒有交代誰、什麼時候或在哪裡，不適合當開頭。

practice.feedback: 開頭要交代場景：'One Saturday morning, Ben and his sister went to the beach.' 說出了什麼時候（Saturday morning）、有誰（Ben and his sister）、在哪裡（the beach）。

practice.stem: 說故事時，要帶出『最後發生』的那件事，下面哪個時間順序詞最合適？
practice.answer: Finally
options: Finally
First
Then
Before

distractor_rationales.First: First 用來帶出『最先發生』的事，不是最後。
distractor_rationales.Then: Then 用來帶出『接下來』的事（中間），不是最後。
distractor_rationales.Before: Before 表示『在…之前』，不能用來帶出故事最後發生的那件事。

practice.feedback: 要帶出最後發生的事用 Finally，例如 'Finally, they went home feeling happy.'；First 是最先、Then 是接下來。

practice.stem: 四格圖依序是：(1) 一個男孩種下種子、(2) 他澆水、(3) 一株小植物長出來、(4) 植物開了花。下面哪個句子順序正確地照著圖說出這個故事？
practice.answer: First, a boy planted a seed. Then he watered it. After that, a small plant grew. Finally, it had a flower.
options: First, a boy planted a seed. Then he watered it. After that, a small plant grew. Finally, it had a flower.
First, the plant had a flower. Then a small plant grew. After that, he watered it. Finally, a boy planted a seed.
First, he watered it. Then a boy planted a seed. After that, it had a flower. Finally, a small plant grew.
First, a boy planted a seed. Then a small plant grew. After that, he watered it. Finally, it had a flower.

distractor_rationales.First, the plant had a flower. Then a sm: 這把順序完全倒過來了（先開花、最後才種種子），和圖的順序相反。
distractor_rationales.First, he watered it. Then a boy planted: 順序打亂了，還沒種種子就先澆水，不合邏輯也不照圖。
distractor_rationales.First, a boy planted a seed. Then a smal: 把澆水（第2張圖）排到長出小植物之後，和圖的順序不符。

practice.feedback: 照圖的順序：先種種子、再澆水、接著長出小植物、最後開花——'First, a boy planted a seed. Then he watered it. After that, a small plant grew. Finally, it had a flower.'。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的故事出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊檢查『有沒有開始、經過、結果』『時間順序詞有沒有把事件照順序連起來』。

lines.text: One Saturday morning, Ben and his sister went to the beach.
First, a boy planted a seed. Then he watered it every day.

units.title_zh: 說明文＋合併句子（expository writing & sentence combining）
units.can_do: 我能寫一段清楚解釋一個主題或做法的說明文，也能用 and／but／because／who／which 把兩三個短句合併成一個通順的句子。
units.situation_group: 寫作：說明文與合併句子
units.subject: eng

claims.text: An expository paragraph explains a topic or how to do something clearly. It gives facts and steps, not the writer's feelings or a made-up story. Its goal is to help the reader understand or learn something.
claims.verification_ref: 說明文清楚解釋一個主題或做法；它提供事實和步驟，而不是作者的感受或虛構故事；目的是幫讀者理解或學會某件事；屬英語文體通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In an expository paragraph, put the information in a sensible order. When you explain how to do something, give the steps in the order the reader should do them, often with words like 'first', 'next', 'then', and 'finally'.
claims.verification_ref: 說明文要把資訊照合理的順序排列；解釋如何做某事時，依讀者該做的先後給出步驟，常用 first／next／then／finally 等詞；屬英語說明文通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: You can join two short sentences into one with a linking word. Use 'and' to add related ideas, 'but' to show a contrast, and 'because' to give a reason. The linking word you choose must match the meaning.
claims.verification_ref: 可以用連接詞把兩個短句合併成一句：and 補充相關的想法、but 表轉折、because 說明原因；選的連接詞要符合句意；屬英語句子合併通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: You can join two sentences about the same noun with a relative pronoun: use 'who' for a person and 'which' for a thing or animal. This lets you avoid repeating the noun, as in 'I have a friend who lives in Japan.'
claims.verification_ref: 可以用關係代名詞把講同一個名詞的兩句合併：人用 who、東西或動物用 which；這樣就不必重複那個名詞，例如 'I have a friend who lives in Japan.'；屬英語關係子句基礎；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: An expository paragraph explains a topic or how to do something clearly. It gives facts and steps, not your feelings or a made-up story. Start with a sentence that names the topic, then explain it point by point or step by step. Put the information in a sensible order; when you explain how to do something, give the steps in the order the reader should follow, using words like 'first', 'next', 'then', and 'finally'.
teach.zh_hint: 說明文清楚解釋一個主題或做法。它提供事實和步驟，不是你的感受或虛構故事。先用一句點出主題，再一點一點或一步一步解釋。把資訊照合理的順序排好；解釋怎麼做某事時，依讀者該做的先後給出步驟，用 first／next／then／finally 等詞。

teach.body: You can join short sentences into one smoother sentence. Use 'and' to add related ideas ('Tom likes soccer and basketball.'), 'but' to show a contrast ('I like tea, but I don't like coffee.'), and 'because' to give a reason ('I went to bed early because I was tired.'). For two sentences about the same noun, use 'who' for a person and 'which' for a thing, so you do not repeat the noun ('I have a friend who lives in Japan.'). Choose the linking word that matches the meaning.
teach.zh_hint: 你可以把短句合併成一個更通順的句子。用 and 補充相關想法（'Tom likes soccer and basketball.'）、用 but 表轉折（'I like tea, but I don't like coffee.'）、用 because 說明原因（'I went to bed early because I was tired.'）。講同一個名詞的兩句，人用 who、東西用 which，就不必重複名詞（'I have a friend who lives in Japan.'）。選的連接詞要符合句意。

teach.body: Model expository paragraph: 'Making a cup of tea is easy. First, boil some water. Next, put a tea bag in a cup. Then pour in the hot water and wait two minutes. Finally, take out the tea bag, and your tea is ready.' Notice the clear topic sentence, the steps in order, and how 'and' joins two short ideas in the last step.
teach.zh_hint: 範例說明文：'Making a cup of tea is easy. First, boil some water. Next, put a tea bag in a cup. Then pour in the hot water and wait two minutes. Finally, take out the tea bag, and your tea is ready.'。注意清楚的主題句、照順序的步驟，以及最後一步用 'and' 把兩個短想法連起來。

teach.body: Your turn: write the first sentence of an expository paragraph that explains how to wash your hands. It should name the topic and sound like an explanation, not a story or your feelings. Example answers: Washing your hands well is easy if you follow these steps. / Here is a simple way to keep your hands clean.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：為一段「怎麼洗手」的說明文寫第一句。要點出主題、聽起來像在解釋，而不是故事或感受。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有點出主題＋像說明（不是講故事或感想）即可（用字可不同）。範例：Washing your hands well is easy if you follow these steps.／Here is a simple way to keep your hands clean.。

teach.body: Your turn: combine these two sentences into one using 'because' — 'I stayed home.' + 'I was sick.' Example answer: I stayed home because I was sick.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：用 'because' 把這兩句合併成一句——'I stayed home.' + 'I was sick.'（第二句是原因）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：用 because 接出原因、整句通順即可。正解：I stayed home because I was sick.。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句最適合當一段「說明如何泡一杯茶」的說明文開頭（像在解釋，不是講故事或感受）？
practice.answer: Making a cup of tea is easy if you follow these steps.
options: Making a cup of tea is easy if you follow these steps.
I really love drinking tea with my grandma.
Suddenly, the hot cup fell off the table!
The tea tasted so sweet and warm.

distractor_rationales.I really love drinking tea with my grand: 這是在講個人感受，不是清楚解釋『怎麼泡茶』的說明。
distractor_rationales.Suddenly, the hot cup fell off the table: 這是故事裡的一個突發事件（記敘），不是說明文的開頭。
這是描述感受／味道，不是解釋做法的說明。

practice.feedback: 說明文要清楚解釋做法：'Making a cup of tea is easy if you follow these steps.' 點出主題、引出後面的步驟，是說明文的開頭。

practice.stem: 說明「怎麼泡一杯茶」時，下面哪個步驟順序最合理（說明文要照合理順序）？
practice.answer: First, boil the water. Next, put a tea bag in a cup. Then, pour in the hot water. Finally, wait two minutes.
options: First, boil the water. Next, put a tea bag in a cup. Then, pour in the hot water. Finally, wait two minutes.
First, pour in the hot water. Next, boil the water. Then, wait two minutes. Finally, put a tea bag in a cup.
First, wait two minutes. Next, pour in the hot water. Then, boil the water. Finally, put a tea bag in a cup.
First, put a tea bag in a cup. Next, wait two minutes. Then, boil the water. Finally, pour in the hot water.

distractor_rationales.First, pour in the hot water. Next, boil: 還沒把水煮開就先倒熱水，順序不合理。
distractor_rationales.First, wait two minutes. Next, pour in t: 一開始什麼都還沒做就先等兩分鐘，順序不合理。
distractor_rationales.First, put a tea bag in a cup. Next, wai: 把煮水、倒水排到最後，茶包卻先泡空等兩分鐘，順序不合理。

practice.feedback: 合理順序是：先煮水、放茶包、倒熱水、再等兩分鐘——'First, boil the water. Next, put a tea bag in a cup. Then, pour in the hot water. Finally, wait two minutes.'。

practice.stem: 把這兩句合併成一句最通順：'Tom likes soccer.' + 'Tom likes basketball.' 哪一句合併得正確又通順？
practice.answer: Tom likes soccer and basketball.
options: Tom likes soccer and basketball.
Tom likes soccer but basketball.
Tom likes soccer because basketball.
Tom likes soccer, he likes basketball.

but 表『轉折、相反』，但喜歡足球和籃球是同方向的事，不該用 but。
because 要接一個說明原因的子句，這裡接 basketball 不成句，意思也不通。
只用逗號把兩個完整句湊在一起（逗號接合），沒有真正合併，應該用連接詞。

practice.feedback: 兩個同方向、相關的想法用 and 合併：'Tom likes soccer and basketball.'——不必重複 'Tom likes'。

practice.stem: 用 who 或 which 把這兩句合併：'I have a friend.' + 'She lives in Japan.' 哪一句正確又通順？
practice.answer: I have a friend who lives in Japan.
options: I have a friend who lives in Japan.
I have a friend which lives in Japan.
I have a friend who live in Japan.
I have a friend, who she lives in Japan.

which 用於東西或動物，講『人』要用 who。
who 代表的是單數的 a friend，動詞要用 lives（加 -s），不是 live。
已經用了 who 就不必再放 she，兩個都留下重複了主詞。

practice.feedback: 講同一個人用 who 合併、不必重複名詞：'I have a friend who lives in Japan.'；who 代表單數的 friend，動詞用 lives。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的說明段落和合併好的句子出聲讀一遍，檢查『步驟順序合不合理』『連接詞 and／but／because／who／which 用得對不對、句子通不通順』。

lines.text: Making a cup of tea is easy. First, boil some water.
I have a friend who lives in Japan.

units.title_zh: 中譯英＋寫出自然英文（translate into natural English）
units.can_do: 我能把簡單的中文句子翻成自然的英文，先懂整句意思再用英文說，而不是一字一字直譯，寫出道地、不彆扭的英文。
units.situation_group: 寫作：中譯英與自然英文
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When you translate a Chinese sentence into English, express the meaning, not each word. First understand the whole meaning, then say it the way an English speaker would. A word-by-word translation often sounds strange.
claims.verification_ref: 把中文句翻成英文時，要翻『意思』而不是逐字翻；先懂整句意思，再用英語母語者的說法說出來；逐字直譯常聽起來彆扭；屬翻譯與英語表達通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Some everyday Chinese phrases use a different verb in natural English. The idea of '開燈' is said as 'turn on the light', and '坐公車' is said as 'take the bus'. Natural English uses these set phrases, so a word-by-word version like 'open the light' sounds strange.
claims.verification_ref: 一些日常中文說法在自然英文裡用不同的動詞：『開燈』說 turn on the light、『坐公車』說 take the bus；道地英文用這些固定說法，逐字直譯成 open the light 聽起來彆扭；屬英語搭配／片語通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In English you use only one connecting word where Chinese may use a pair. '雖然…但是…' becomes just 'Although ..., ...' with no extra 'but', and '因為…所以…' becomes just 'Because ..., ...' with no extra 'so'. Adding the second connector is not natural English.
claims.verification_ref: 英文在中文用成對連接詞的地方只用一個：『雖然…但是…』只用 Although …, …（後半不再加 but）、『因為…所以…』只用 Because …, …（後半不再加 so）；多加第二個連接詞不是自然英文；屬英語連接詞用法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you translate a sentence into English, translate the meaning, not each separate word. First read the whole sentence and make sure you understand it. Then say the same idea the way an English speaker would. For example, the idea of walking to school every day is simply 'I walk to school every day.' If you move the words one by one in Chinese order, the English can sound strange, so always check that your English sentence sounds natural.
teach.zh_hint: 把句子翻成英文時，翻的是『意思』，不是一個一個字。先讀完整句、確定你懂它的意思。然後用英語母語者的說法把同樣的意思說出來。例如「每天走路上學」這個意思，英文就是 'I walk to school every day.'。如果照中文語序一字一字搬，英文會聽起來彆扭，所以要檢查你的英文句子是不是自然。

teach.body: Natural English sometimes uses different words from a word-by-word translation. For the idea of switching on a light, English says 'turn on the light', and for riding a bus, English says 'take the bus'. Also, English uses only one connecting word where another language may use a pair: the idea of 'although ... but ...' is just 'Although ..., ...' in English, with no extra 'but'. Learning these natural phrases helps your English sound clear and real.
teach.zh_hint: 自然的英文有時用的字和逐字翻不同。「開燈」這個意思，英文說 'turn on the light'；「坐公車」英文說 'take the bus'。另外，中文用成對連接詞的地方英文只用一個：『雖然…但是…』英文只用 'Although ..., ...'，後半不再加 but。學會這些道地說法，你的英文會更清楚、更自然。

teach.body: Compare a word-by-word version with natural English. Idea 1 (turning on the light): word-by-word 'open the light' sounds strange; natural English is 'Please turn on the light.' Idea 2 (although it rained): a double connector 'Although it rained, but we went out.' is not natural; natural English is 'Although it rained, we still went out.' A word-by-word translation is often not the natural way to say it in English.
teach.zh_hint: 比較逐字版和自然英文。意思一（開燈）：逐字版 'open the light' 聽起來彆扭；自然英文是 'Please turn on the light.'。意思二（雖然下雨）：用成對連接詞 'Although it rained, but we went out.' 不自然；自然英文是 'Although it rained, we still went out.'。逐字直譯常常不是英文裡自然的說法。

teach.body: Your turn: translate the Chinese sentence in the hint into natural English (translate the meaning, not word by word). Example answer: I go to school by bus every day.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把下面這句中文翻成自然的英文（翻意思、不要逐字翻）——「我每天坐公車上學。」。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：翻出意思、用自然說法（例如 take the bus／by bus）、整句通順即可（用字可不同）。範例：I go to school by bus every day.。

teach.body: Your turn: make this sentence sound like natural English by using only one connector — 'Although I was tired, but I finished my homework.' Example answer: Although I was tired, I finished my homework.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這句改成自然英文，只用一個連接詞——'Although I was tired, but I finished my homework.'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：拿掉多餘的 but、只留 Although 即可。正解：Although I was tired, I finished my homework.。

practice.stem: 下面這句中文「我每天走路上學。」最自然的英文說法是哪一個？
practice.answer: I walk to school every day.
options: I walk to school every day.
I every day walk to school.
I am walk to school every day.
I walk to go to school every day.

把「每天」照中文語序硬塞在主詞後面，英文語序不自然（every day 一般放句尾）。
am 後面不能直接接原形動詞 walk，文法錯誤。
多了 'to go'，是把「走路去上學」逐字直譯的彆扭說法。

practice.feedback: 翻意思、用自然語序：'I walk to school every day.'——每天（every day）放句尾才自然。

practice.stem: 「請開燈。」最自然、道地的英文是哪一個？
practice.answer: Please turn on the light.
options: Please turn on the light.
Please open the light.
Please open the lamp.
Please give the light.

把「開」逐字翻成 open，英文不這樣說燈；道地說法是 turn on the light。
同樣把「開」直譯成 open，open the lamp 也不是自然英文。
give the light 意思不通，不是「開燈」的說法。

practice.feedback: 「開燈」道地的英文用 turn on：'Please turn on the light.'；逐字翻成 open the light 不自然。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句是自然、正確的英文（連接詞沒有多餘）？
practice.answer: Although it was raining, we still went out.
options: Although it was raining, we still went out.
Although it was raining, but we still went out.
